say:1:1510353001:0.source_cn: 说吧，我知道你有结论了。

say:3:1510353002:0.female: We're not all twisted deities who gamble lives on a whim.

say:4:1510353003:0.female: I already know what you're going to say.

say:6:1510353004:0.text: Ioxus, take some men, collect all the locust meat, and burn it to ash.

say:7:1510353005:0.text: Also, send word to Halia. Tell the Regulus and everyone inside that no matter what happens, they shouldn't eat the locusts.
say:7:1510353005:0.source_cn: 发信给呼临城，通知领主和城内的人，无论什么情况，禁食针蝗。

say:11:1510353008:0.text: Now, we have much to discuss...
say:11:1510353008:0.source_cn: 接下来是我们之间的事了……
say:11:1510353008:0.male: Now, we have much to discuss...
say:11:1510353008:0.female: Now, we have much to discuss...

say:12:1510353009:0.text: You call yourself the Hunting God. You should have a way to save them.

say:12:1510353009:0.female: You call yourself the Hunting Goddess. You should have a way to save them.

say:15:1510353011:0.text: I won't abandon my faith, but for the lives of my men... I'll honor you, Herdmaster.
say:15:1510353011:0.source_cn: 我不会背弃自己的信仰，但为了同胞的生命，我会向你献上敬...

say:15:1510353011:0.female: I won't abandon my faith, but for the lives of my men... I'll honor you, Herdmaster.

say:16:1510353012:0.text: No matter what, please save them...

say:16:1510353012:0.female: No matter what, please save them...

choice_prompt:22:1510353014.male: By your will, Herdmaster. Let us mere mortals bear witness to your true power.
choice_prompt:22:1510353014.female: By your will, Herdmaster. Let us mere mortals bear witness to your true power.

say:28:1510355001:0.text: It's a miracle! Their conditions have all improved!

say:35:1510355006:0.text: Regardless, for saving my soldiers, I would like to express my respect and gratitude...

say:38:1510355008:0.female: As expected from a cruel goddess.

say:40:1510355009:0.text: You are wrong. The Hunting God is not cruel.

say:40:1510355009:0.male: You are wrong. The Hunting God is not cruel.
say:40:1510355009:0.female: You are wrong. The Hunting Goddess is not cruel.

say:41:1510355010:0.text: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in his lands and take from his herds, and all we need to do is give him a willing sacrifice.

say:41:1510355010:0.male: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in his lands and take from his herds, and all we need to do is give him a willing sacrifice.
say:41:1510355010:0.female: The Herdmaster allows the Wildborn to live in her lands and take from her herds, and all we need to do is give her a willing sacrifice.

say:42:1510355011:0.text: Therein lies his cruelty! All Wildborn sacrifices, past and present, are wrong! Horribly wrong!

say:42:1510355011:0.female: Therein lies her cruelty! All Wildborn sacrifices, past and present, are wrong! Horribly wrong!

say:44:1510355013:0.female: I am not a killer. I am an emissary of the divine.
